# QYL0102: [Traced] attribute requires non-empty ActivitySourceName

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |

| Analyzer | `Qyl0102TracedActivitySourceNameAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

The [Traced] attribute requires a non-empty ActivitySourceName to identify the source of spans. This name should match a registered ActivitySource in your application's tracing configuration.
